scope: Bind every nonzero DATA-02 backfill cursor to one canonical active-A-share universe identity.

mismatched universe hash reached provider lookup
management command did not pass universe_hash

failing_first_observation.limitation: The failing-first terminal output was observed but not redirected; no timestamp or output was reconstructed.

implemented_contract: The live universe is normalized to uppercase, rejects blanks and duplicates, and is sorted before hashing.
The SHA-256 input is canonical JSON with schema active-a-share-universe.v1 and the complete ordered asset list.
Every checkpoint contains universe_hash; the durable batch idempotency digest also binds the same full hash.
Any nonzero offset requires an exact lowercase SHA-256 supplied from the preceding checkpoint.

A different live universe blocks before provider lookup, preserves the original bound hash, records the newly observed hash separately, resets next_offset to the current offset and persists an explicit universe_hash_mismatch control-plane outcome.
The synchronous management command carries the first checkpoint hash into each later batch automatically.
Equivalent query order converges on the same hash and idempotency identity.

resolved_before_commit: A mismatch checkpoint preserves the original bound hash instead of replacing it with the newly observed hash.
The newly observed hash is recorded separately for diagnosis.
The Application boundary validates expected hash format independently of the Celery adapter.
Non-string universe members are rejected instead of being silently stringified.
independent_review.next_recommended_unit: Add append-only item-attempt durability instead of expanding the 500-character aggregate cursor.

postgresql_component_tests.skip_reason: PostgreSQL-only contention assertions remain skipped when the configured test database is not PostgreSQL.

governance.reason: Resume offsets are now universe-bound, while full failure-item durability, pre-mutation identity rollback and four-Publication tolerance reconciliation remain open.

remaining_repository_gates: Persist complete failed-symbol, domain, attempt, phase, retry-target and stop-reason evidence outside the bounded cursor.
Validate provider identities before fact mutation or rollback the whole mutation on mismatch.
Produce policy-hash-bound numeric tolerance evidence for all four frozen Publications.
